observations.code_quote: "" if _ESCAPED_NEWLINE_LINE_RE.fullmatch(line) else line for line in cleaned.split("\n")
observations.behavior: Adds a post-processing step to remove lines consisting entirely of escaped newline sequences (\\n or \\r\\n).
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the output of `sanitize_prompt` used by AI subscription spec generation; could prevent prompts containing literal backslash-n from being treated as actual newlines.

observations.behavior: Adds regression tests expecting that mixed and repeated escaped-newline-only lines are removed while preserving surrounding text.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests support the behavior change without changing other prompt handling paths.

observations.behavior: Defines a regex pattern matching one or more consecutive escaped newline characters. This is not executed, but its presence supports P1.F1.H2's removal logic.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports the implementation rather than independently changing user-facing behavior.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks provided; no broader context on how this sanitization interacts with downstream HogQL planning or whether it could inadvertently strip legitimate content. No test assertions show failure before and after, only additions.

review.limitations: Only three hunks provided; no broader context on how this sanitization interacts with downstream HogQL planning or whether it could inadvertently strip legitimate content. No test assertions show failure before and after, only additions.
review.reason: The patch adds a bounded, localized capability: removing escaped-newline-only lines in AI subscription prompts. The implementation and relevant checks are visible. It does not demonstrate systemic risk reduction across components, so tier 3 is unsupported.
review.posthog_relevance: Could prevent malformed inputs from reaching HogQL spec generation, potentially improving reliability of scheduled reports. However, benefit depends on actual occurrence of such input patterns, which cannot be established here.
review.uncertainty: Without wider context, we do not know if these escape sequences appear meaningfully in production prompts or if their removal could break expected formatting.
